name: protocadherin alpha 10

function.text: PCDHA10 is the approved symbol for protocadherin alpha 10. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in calcium ion binding; cell adhesion molecule binding; cell adhesion.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Bladder urothelial carcinoma; Glioblastoma; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: PCDHA10 encodes protocadherin alpha 10. Its functions include calcium ion binding and cell adhesion molecule binding.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PCDHA10 have been reported in glioblastoma, low-grade glioma, and lung adenocarcinoma.
